pr.title: Fix proof archive manifest schema drift
pr.body: Reconciles the checked-in proof archive manifest metadata with the proof archive manifest schema. This fixes a pre-existing full-suite failure unrelated to the Claude adapter work.

steps.task: Reproduce the failing test and inspect the runtime proof archive manifest generator, schema, and checked-in archive.
requirements: Run the exact failing test first.
Inspect the manifest inside proof/TP-002-PAL-ENFORCEMENT_PROOF_ARCHIVE.zip without rewriting it.
Determine whether source_path is current runtime output or only stale historical archive drift.

steps.task: Apply the smallest correct fix based on source-of-truth investigation.
requirements: If proof_aggregator.py currently emits source_path intentionally, update PROOF_ARCHIVE_MANIFEST_SCHEMA.json to allow source_path as a string.
If source_path is not current runtime output and only exists in stale checked-in archive data, regenerate or patch only the stale checked-in archive manifest.
If both runtime and checked-in archive behavior disagree, prefer making schema match current runtime output unless there is a strong reason source_path should be removed.
Do not alter unrelated proof schema fields.
Do not relax schema with broad additionalProperties=true.
If allowing source_path, add it as an explicit property only.
Do not modify Claude adapter files.

steps.task: Run focused and full validation, write proof, and commit.
requirements: Run full pytest because this TP specifically targets the prior full-suite failure.
Write a proof JSON with reproduction, root cause, chosen fix, tests, allowlist check, and commit-readiness.
Commit only if tests pass and changed paths are within allowlist.
